scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm --prefix apps/api run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/api run lint && node apps/api/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config apps/api/eslint.config.mjs tests/api --max-warnings 0 && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
